comment: Enable or disable Create: Dragons Plus features
Depending mods may override a feature through fabric.mod.json custom metadata; restart after changes

fluid/dragon_breath/dripstone_duplicatio.comment: Allow Dragon's Breath fluid to fill cauldrons through pointed dripstone

fluid/dye/lava_interaction_generate_colo.comment: Create colored concrete when dye fluid meets lava

fluid/air_current_block_interaction.comment: Allow air currents to interact through fluids

recipe/automatic_brewing/dragon_breath.comment: Generate automated Dragon's Breath brewing recipes

recipe/sand_paper_polishing/polished_blo.comment: Generate polishing recipes for polished blocks

recipe/sand_paper_polishing/oxidized_blo.comment: Generate polishing recipes for oxidized blocks

recipe/sand_paper_polishing/waxed_blocks.comment: Generate polishing recipes for waxed blocks
